method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories using institutional tradition plus temporally gated training, coaching and competition-system evidence.
evidence_rules: Pre-1955 institutional and competition history may anchor tradition but is not treated as measured 1955 participation.
Modern national-centre, coaching and player-support structures are not backcast before their source years.
Competition quality is based on organised competition opportunity and system structure, not a direct conversion of famous-player results.
Historical state names are preserved where materially different from the current country name.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored values.
